manifest.notes: Sepolia-only test toy: the treasury holds donated Sepolia test ETH, and LVOT votes carry no off-chain rights. LaunchToken has no constructor arguments. LockVoteTreasury takes the launch token address, stores it immutably, and needs no initial LVOT or ETH, owner, or initialization call. Users acquire LVOT through the factory-seeded ETH/LVOT pool and approve the treasury before locking. Whoever locks a quorum can pass an unopposed proposal; the one-day execution delay gives visibility only. The pool has no hook. The manifest price is decimal sqrtPriceX96; a policy-pinned opening market cap determines the effective opening price when present. Services own policy, signed artifact linkage, publication, attestation, admission, and deployment. These notes are explanatory and confer no deployment authority.
